scope: Read-only run artifacts; only this report is written in /tmp. No GPU or process check required.

source_schema.shape: 10 triangular rows, row t contains t+1 seen-task accuracies
source_schema.evaluation: native CNN argmax over all seen classes
source_schema.native_source: trainer/four_probe_train.py evaluate -> trainer/native_lifecycle.py seen_accuracy_row(cnn,...), reading cnn["grouped"]["00-19" ... "180-199"]
source_schema.future_keys: future NaN placeholders are excluded from observed matrix
source_schema.precision: stored task accuracies are native percentages (two decimal places); no underlying prediction counts reconstructed
source_schema.forgetting: (1/9)*sum_j=0..8 (max_{t=j..9} A[t,j]-A[9,j]); includes final stage in max, excludes newest task; not simply -BWT
source_schema.sample_weighted: AAA_sample_weighted/FAA_sample_weighted separately stored; not used as primary AAA/FAA
